title: Covered Insurer Deductible by Loss Type and Waiver Age
content:
# Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — Claims Rider: Covered Insurer Deductible

**Rider clause.** On a GAP balance line under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda, the covered deductible depends on the loss type and on how long the waiver had been in force at the loss. Both are read from the waiver's most recent GAP balance claim line.

- **Total-loss theft, waiver in force 12 or more months at the loss:** the covered deductible is the greater of the tier's covered-deductible cap and 1,500.00 (USD 1500.00).
- **Total-loss collision, waiver in force fewer than 12 months at the loss:** the covered deductible is the greater of the tier's covered-deductible cap and 1,250.00 (USD 1250.00).
- **Every other case:** the covered deductible is the tier's covered-deductible cap. This covers a theft in the first 12 months, a collision after 12 months, and any other total loss.

The insurer's deductible is covered up to the covered deductible. Any deductible above that amount is subtracted from the GAP balance.

**Months in force.** These are the whole calendar months from the waiver's sale date to the loss date. A month counts each time the sale date's day of the month is reached. A loss date on an earlier day of the month does not complete the month, and there is no month-end adjustment.

### Grid by tier

| Waiver | Tier covered-deductible cap | Theft, 12 months or more | Collision, under 12 months | Every other case |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | 0.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 0.00 |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | 500.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 500.00 |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | 500.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 500.00 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | 1,000.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 1,000.00 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | 1,000.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 1,000.00 |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | 0.00 | 1,500.00 | 1,250.00 | 0.00 |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A waiver sold on 14 May of Year 1 has a theft loss on 14 May of Year 2. That is 12 months in force, so the theft row applies. A loss on 13 May of Year 2 is 11 months, so the every-other-case row applies.
- A collision loss on 13 May of Year 2 is 11 months in force, so the collision row applies. On 14 May of Year 2 it is 12 months, so the every-other-case row applies.
- Under a tier with a 500.00 cap, a theft loss after 12 months with a 2,000.00 insurer deductible: 1,500.00 is covered and 500.00 is subtracted.
